items.scene: A CALF (KAHV) naps on a bed of straw at the foot of the stone steps, down here in the vaulted wine CELLAR.
A BOOT (boo-TEHY) is stuck upside down in the neck of a huge green BOTTLE standing on the cellar floor.
A grey-moustached waiter hurries his tray of empty shiny BRASS tankards (brah-suh-REE) up to the BRASSERIE.
An old winemaker leans on his barrel and presses a big red wax seal onto a bottle: by decree, a wine of NAMED ORIGIN (ah-pay-lah-SYOHN, like 'a-PELL-ation').

EVE won't REST (ee-VREHS): barefoot in the grape tub she stomps and stomps, laughing, until her feet are purple and little stars spin round her head: the HEADY, DIZZY whirl of grape-stomping. Nothing in her hands, no glass.
A white goat sniffs glass after glass at the little TASTING table, unsure whether to be DISGUSTED (day-GEWS-) or delighted; nobody drinks.
A squirrel wears a shiny bottle CAP as a helmet (kahp-SEWL) while hugging his acorn: a CAPSULE hat!
A crow perched on the ice bucket croaks 'KAH!' (vod-KAH) at the frosty VODKA bottle chilling inside.
A TEENY gnome (VEENY) stands at the foot of the stone pillar wrapped in a curling grape VINE heavy with purple bunches.
A woman balances a GLASS of red wine on her head and shrugs 'WHERE?' (VEHR): it is right on top of her!
